prompt: Of the three producers of the tv sitcom Friends, which two had ties to Philadelphia?
answer: Marta Kauffman and David Crane had ties to Philadelphia. Kauffman was born and raised in the Philadelphia area, while Crane was born in New Jersey and grew up connected to Philadelphia through his father, Philadelphia TV personality Gene Crane.
